description: Cat slide roof to front incorporating front canopy; conversion of garage to habitable room; single and two storey side to rear extensions; alterations and extension to roof; rooflights in front and rear roofslopes; rear patio; landscaping; external alterations and replacement windows (Part demolition of first floor front and side)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p class="MsoNormal">The proposed front garden soft landscaping works shown on
the proposed plans shall be installed in accordance with the proposed plans,
and retained as such thereafter, if the additional hardstanding works as
proposed are undertaken.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">The brickwork bond (ie arrangement of bricks) for the
proposed works shall match the existing.&nbsp;<span lang="EN-US"><o:p></o:p></span></p>
<p>The proposed rooflights shall be 'conservation style' rooflights and should be flush with the roofline.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal">The new hardstanding hereby approved shall match the exiting
in type, colour and design.<o:p></o:p></p>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p class="MsoNormal">Prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the works,
samples of brickwork and pointing shall be provided to, and approved in writing
by, the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the relevant part
of the works.<o:p></o:p></p>
